claims.note: Smoke, chain cycles 1-3, and background-overlap rows report PQ pivots/codes changed; non-PQ staged files are hardlinked/full-hash preserved; graph/layout/live compact/tag map/tombstone flags are false.

claims.claim: A PQ-only serving prefix loads, preserves non-PQ graph/layout files, changes PQ hashes, and searches successfully.
claims.note: Smoke selected row recall=98.05, avg=8.442ms, p95=8.774ms.

claims.claim: PQ-only maintenance alone satisfies at least five 60% mark-delete/insert cycles with recall>=98 and avg/p95<10ms.
claims.note: Run stopped by fast-fail at cycle03_pq_only_chain_intersect_u75: recall=98.25 but avg=10.959ms and p95=12.330ms. Only 14/30 expected selected rows were produced.

claims.claim: If PQ-only is insufficient, residual non-PQ causes are diagnosed from route, recall, latency, IO/candidate metrics and full-rebuild comparison.
claims.note: Failing point needs prefilter L400 over 750k candidates; graph route reaches only 97.40 recall by L500. Full rebuild analog passes latency, so residual issue is graph/topology/incremental layout/prefilter pressure, not PQ sidecar alone.

claims.claim: Low-core PQ-only background maintenance can run without pushing a near-boundary foreground search over recall/avg/p95 gates.
claims.note: One background rebuild on CPU15/cap=1 took 42.687s; 5 foreground rows on CPUs0-14 had recall min 98.08, max avg 9.898ms, max p95 9.940ms. This does not prove full graph rebuild/compact/layout/space maintenance.

claims.claim: PQ-only chain does not alter or re-prove 4KB node layout, packing, label sidecar, or strict space ratio claims.
claims.note: Use previous v100 layout/space audit for strict total about 1.9806x raw vector and label sidecar violations=0; this PQ-only run only replaces same-size PQ sidecars.
